description: The license policy of the CLI archive's npm dependencies (release/lib/notices.mjs, with the reasoner's policy code). A package whose license is not allowed, or that ships no license file and is not listed under withoutLicenseFile, fails the build.

@msgpackr-extract/msgpackr-extract-*.reason: the per-platform prebuilt addon of msgpackr-extract, published from the same repository under the same MIT license, whose LICENSE covers it

oxigraph.reason: the oxigraph npm package ships no license file; it is dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0 and MIT is selected
